title: SQL DDL to Prisma Schema

seo.title: SQL DDL to Prisma Schema — Private, Browser-Based Draft Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Conservative conversion deliberately rejects unsupported SQL constructs rather than producing subtly broken relations.
seo.h1: Convert plain CREATE TABLE SQL into Prisma models

requirements.runtime: browser, compiled via existing lazy route loader

input: textarea and optional file local read
limitations: DDL grammars differ across vendors. This deliberately excludes foreign keys, advanced defaults, CHECK constraints and full relation reconstruction. For actual databases prefer Prisma introspection.
